reconstruction.download: Download the raw_url at the immutable upstream_commit; do not use a moving branch.
reconstruction.authenticate: Require both GitHub Contents API blob metadata and an independently reconstructed Git blob-object SHA-1 to equal upstream_git_blob_sha1, and require raw SHA-256 to equal raw_file_sha256.
reconstruction.derive: Run scripts/backfill_train_source_doi.py with --require-official-git-blob-sha and --expected-raw-sha256. The upstream raw CSV is not redistributed in this repository.
